'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**[[2025 Hadhramaut offensive]]
***The [[Southern Transitional Council]] (STC) captures all eight southern [[Governorates of Yemen|governorates]] of [[Yemen]], opening possibilities for it to claim [[South Yemen|independence]]. [[Saudi Arabia]] withdraws all of its troops from [[Aden]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/dec/08/seizure-south-yemen-uae-backed-forces-could-lead-independence-claim (''The Guardian'')]
***Yemen's [[airspace]] briefly closes as a result of the STC offensive. [https://apnews.com/article/yemen-civil-war-saudi-arabia-uae-d29e9a9d3cb60c8c1b009bfcbe1c28c0 (AP)]
*[[2025 Cambodia‒Thailand conflict]]
**A [[Royal Thai Army|Thai soldier]] is killed and eight others are injured after [[Cambodia]] shells [[Ubon Ratchathani province]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/3152249/thai-soldiers-killed-injured-as-cambodia-resumes-fires-at-thai-soil (''Bangkok Post'')]
**[[Royal Thai Air Force|Thai]] [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16]] jets carry out [[airstrike]]s on [[Royal Cambodian Armed Forces|Cambodian military]] targets in [[Oddar Meanchey province]] and [[Preah Vihear]], killing four [[Cambodians|Cambodian]] civilians and wounding ten more. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/8/thailand-launches-air-raids-along-border-with-cambodia-after-deadly-clashes (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Israel]] carries out a wave of [[airstrike]]s in southern [[Lebanon]], allegedly targeting [[Hezbollah]]'s site. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/9/israel-launches-new-wave-of-air-attacks-on-lebanon-straining-fragile-truce (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[Rapid Support Forces]] capture [[Heglig]], [[Sudan]]'s largest [[Petroleum reservoir|oilfield]], after the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] withdraw from the area. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/8/rsf-claims-seizure-of-key-heglig-oil-field-in-sudan (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[83rd Golden Globe Awards]]
**Nominations for the [[Golden Globe Awards]] honoring productions in 2025 are released, with ''[[One Battle After Another]]'' topping the film categories with 9 nominations, while ''[[The White Lotus]]'' tops the television categories with 6 nominations. This is also the first year the awards will have a Best Podcast category. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/8/2026-golden-globes-which-films-got-nominations-and-who-was-snubbed (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/golden-globes-podcast-category-a9a56d6302aa99e20b753b76e2df35c1 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Czech Republic–Turkey relations]]
**[[Turkey|Turkish]] [[Low-cost carrier|low-cost airline]] [[Pegasus Airlines|Pegasus]] announces an agreement to [[Mergers and acquisitions|acquire]] [[Czech Airlines]] and its subsidiary [[Smartwings]], the largest [[Czech Republic|Czech]] airline, for {{Euro}}154 million (US$180 million). [https://apnews.com/article/turkish-airline-pegasus-smartwings-621b4c70fbb52ae7b3c17079e829b786 (AP)]
*[[Economy of China]]
**[[China]]'s [[trade surplus]] passes US$1 trillion for the first time despite significant pressure from [[United States|U.S.]] [[Tariffs in the second Trump administration|tariffs]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/12/08/nx-s1-5637270/china-trade-surplus-tariffs (NPR)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Aomori earthquake]]
**A {{M|w|7.6}} [[earthquake]] strikes off the coast of [[Aomori Prefecture]], [[Japan]], causing some [[public service]]s to be suspended. [https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20251208/p2g/00m/0na/045000c (Mainichi)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/12/08/japan-earthquake-tsunami-warnings.html (CNBC)]
*Four tourists are killed and one other is missing when a wave hits a seawater pool in [[Los Gigantes]], [[Tenerife]], [[Spain]]. The victims had previously ignored the warnings and the closure of the seawater pool. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-tenerife-vacationers-swimmers-pool-sea-deaths-95d9cbc6146c5bcb336f67af82d998fa (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Hungary–Turkey relations]]
**[[Turkey]] agrees to guarantee the transit of [[Natural gas in Russia|Russian natural gas]] to [[Hungary]] through the [[TurkStream]] [[pipeline]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/turkey-guarantee-flow-russian-gas-hungary-orban-says-2025-12-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Cuba]]
**[[Cuba]]'s [[People's Supreme Court of Cuba|Supreme Court]] sentences former [[Economy of Cuba|economy]] [[Council of Ministers (Cuba)|minister]] Alejandro Gil to [[life imprisonment]] for [[espionage]] and multiple economic-related offenses, and in a separate case imposes a 20-year term for [[bribery]], [[influence peddling]], and [[Taxation in Cuba|tax]] evasion. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/former-cuban-minister-sentenced-to-life-in-prison-for-spying/ (AFP via CTV News)]
*[[Corruption in Ecuador]]
**An [[Ecuador]]ian judge orders former [[President of Ecuador|president]] [[Lenín Moreno]] to stand trial on bribery charges linked to alleged payments made during the construction of the [[Coca Codo Sinclair Dam]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/ecuadorean-judge-orders-former-president-moreno-stand-trial-2025-12-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[Corruption in Mexico]]
**In [[Mexico]], former [[Chihuahua (state)|Chihuahua]] [[Governor of Chihuahua|governor]] [[César Duarte Jáquez]] is arrested for allegedly [[Money laundering|laundering]] more than [[Mexican peso|Mex$]]96 million (US$5 million) in public funds. [https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/former-mexico-governor-arrested-alleged-money-laundering-2025-12-08/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Honduras|Honduran]] [[Public Prosecutor's Office (Honduras)|attorney general]] issues an [[international arrest warrant]] for former [[President of Honduras|president]] [[Juan Orlando Hernández]], whom [[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] recently [[Federal pardons in the United States|pardoned]] after serving part of a 45-year sentence for [[Illegal drug trade in the United States|drug trafficking]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/honduras-ag-issues-international-arrest-warrant-pardoned-ex-president-hernandez-2025-12-08/ (Reuters)]
*A former teacher in [[Dublin]] is jailed for ten years for indecent assault of eight boys. [https://dublinpeople.com/news/court/articles/2025/12/08/former-school-teacher-jailed-for-10-years/ (Dublin People)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Honduran general election]]
**The [[National Electoral Council (Honduras)|Honduran electoral council]] resumes releasing updated [[President of Honduras|president]]ial election results following an extended pause to conduct technical reviews and address inconsistencies in tally sheets, with the latest count showing [[National Party of Honduras|National Party]] candidate [[Nasry Asfura]] narrowly ahead. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/honduras-resumes-releasing-election-results-trump-backed-asfura-maintains-lead-2025-12-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[Singapore]] publishes the [[Albatross file]], revealing [[declassification|previously-classified]] information about the [[Proclamation of Singapore]] and events leading up to the [[Independence of Singapore Agreement 1965|independence of Singapore]] for the first time in public view. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/albatross-file-singapore-independence-declassified-national-library-exhibition-malaysia-separation-5493396 (CNA)]
